parameters.query: SET @nexus_param_1=$1,@nexus_param_2=$2,@nexus_param_3=$3,@nexus_param_4=$4,@nexus_param_5=$5,@nexus_param_6=$6,@nexus_param_7=$7,@nexus_param_8=$8,@nexus_param_9=$9,@nexus_param_10=$10,@nexus_param_11=$11,@nexus_param_12=$12; SET @nexus_new_alert = 0; SET @nexus_ticket_time = COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@nexus_param_8,'T',' '),'Z',''),'+00:00',''),26), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)); INSERT IGNORE INTO security_incident_alerts (alert_id,receipt_id,ticket_id,rule_id,event_type,user_name,src_ip,event_count,occurred_at,event_payload) VALUES (@nexus_param_1,@nexus_param_2,NULL,@nexus_param_3,@nexus_param_4,@nexus_param_5,@nexus_param_6,@nexus_param_7,@nexus_ticket_time,CAST(@nexus_param_9 AS JSON)); SET @nexus_new_alert = ROW_COUNT(); INSERT INTO security_incident_tickets (ticket_key,status,src_ip,ticket_type,type_rank,event_count,rule_ids,user_names,first_seen,last_seen,latest_event,responses) SELECT @nexus_param_10,'open',@nexus_param_6,@nexus_param_11,@nexus_param_12,@nexus_param_7,JSON_ARRAY(@nexus_param_3),IF(@nexus_param_5='',JSON_ARRAY(),JSON_ARRAY(@nexus_param_5)), @nexus_ticket_time,@nexus_ticket_time,CAST(@nexus_param_9 AS JSON),JSON_ARRAY() FROM DUAL WHERE @nexus_new_alert=1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ticket_type=IF(VALUES(type_rank)>type_rank,VALUES(ticket_type),ticket_type), type_rank=GREATEST(type_rank,VALUES(type_rank)), event_count=event_count+VALUES(event_count), rule_ids=IF(JSON_CONTAINS(rule_ids,JSON_QUOTE(@nexus_param_3)),rule_ids,JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(rule_ids,'$',@nexus_param_3)), user_names=IF(@nexus_param_5='',user_names,IF(JSON_CONTAINS(user_names,JSON_QUOTE(@nexus_param_5)),user_names,JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(user_names,'$',@nexus_param_5))), last_seen=GREATEST(last_seen,VALUES(last_seen)), latest_event=VALUES(latest_event); SET @nexus_ticket_id = IF(@nexus_new_alert=1, (SELECT id FROM security_incident_tickets WHERE active_ticket_key=CONVERT(@nexus_param_10 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1),NULL); UPDATE security_incident_alerts SET ticket_id=@nexus_ticket_id WHERE alert_id=CONVERT(@nexus_param_1 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND @nexus_new_alert=1; SELECT (a.receipt_id=CONVERT(@nexus_param_2 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS ticket_is_new,(a.receipt_id<>CONVERT(@nexus_param_2 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS ticket_duplicate, t.id AS ticket_db_id,CONCAT('NX-DB-',LPAD(t.id,6,'0')) AS ticket_id,t.ticket_type, t.event_count AS ticket_event_total,t.rule_ids AS ticket_rules,t.user_names AS ticket_users, t.status,t.first_seen,t.last_seen,a.alert_id FROM security_incident_alerts a LEFT JOIN security_incident_tickets t ON t.id=a.ticket_id WHERE a.alert_id=CONVERT(@nexus_param_1 USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
  'id',id,'ticket_key',ticket_key,'status',status,'src_ip',src_ip,'ticket_type',ticket_type,
  'type_rank',type_rank,'event_count',event_count,'rule_ids',rule_ids,'user_names',user_names,
  'first_seen',DATE_FORMAT(first_seen,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),
  'last_seen',DATE_FORMAT(last_seen,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),
  'latest_event',latest_event,'resolution',resolution,'closed_at',closed_at,'note',note,'responses',responses
)),JSON_ARRAY()) AS ticket_rows
FROM (SELECT * FROM security_incident_tickets ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 500) AS tickets

SELECT t.id AS ticket_db_id, t.ticket_key AS ticket_db_key, t.status AS ticket_db_status, t.src_ip AS ticket_db_src_ip,
  t.user_names AS ticket_db_users, t.ticket_type AS ticket_db_type, t.event_count AS ticket_db_count,
  t.rule_ids AS ticket_db_rules, t.first_seen AS ticket_db_first_seen, t.last_seen AS ticket_db_last_seen,
  t.latest_event AS ticket_db_latest, t.responses AS ticket_db_responses,
  CAST($1 AS JSON) AS body, $2 AS response_mode, CAST($3 AS UNSIGNED) AS live_enabled,
  CAST($4 AS UNSIGNED) AS lock_minutes, CAST($5 AS JSON) AS whitelist_ips
FROM (SELECT 1) AS request
LEFT JOIN security_incident_tickets t
  ON CONCAT('NX-DB-', LPAD(t.id, 6, '0')) = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CAST($6 AS JSON), '$.ticket_id'))

UPDATE security_incident_tickets SET resolution=IF($1 IN ('close','false_positive') AND status='open',$2,resolution), closed_at=IF($3 IN ('close','false_positive') AND status='open',UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),closed_at), note=IF($4 IN ('close','false_positive') AND status='open',$5,note), responses=IF($6 IS NULL,COALESCE(responses,JSON_ARRAY()),JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(IF(JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(responses,JSON_ARRAY()))>=30,JSON_REMOVE(COALESCE(responses,JSON_ARRAY()),'$[0]'),COALESCE(responses,JSON_ARRAY())),'$',CAST($7 AS JSON))), status=IF($8 IN ('close','false_positive') AND status='open','closed',status) WHERE id=$9 AND ($10 NOT IN ('close','false_positive') OR status='open'); SET @nexus_ticket_changed=ROW_COUNT(); SELECT @nexus_ticket_changed AS changed,t.id,t.ticket_key,t.status,t.src_ip,t.ticket_type,t.event_count,t.rule_ids,t.user_names,t.first_seen,t.last_seen,t.latest_event,t.resolution,t.closed_at,t.note,t.responses FROM (SELECT 1) AS request LEFT JOIN security_incident_tickets t ON t.id=$11;

INSERT IGNORE INTO security_discord_rate_limit(id,next_allowed_at) VALUES (1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)); UPDATE security_discord_rate_limit SET next_allowed_at=GREATEST(next_allowed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))+INTERVAL 1 SECOND WHERE id=1; SELECT DATE_FORMAT(next_allowed_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS resume_at,$1 AS message FROM security_discord_rate_limit WHERE id=1;

INSERT IGNORE INTO security_discord_rate_limit(id,next_allowed_at) VALUES (1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)); UPDATE security_discord_rate_limit SET next_allowed_at=GREATEST(next_allowed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))+INTERVAL 1 SECOND WHERE id=1; SELECT DATE_FORMAT(next_allowed_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS resume_at,$1 AS message FROM security_discord_rate_limit WHERE id=1;

SELECT $1 AS assessment_id,$2 AS requested_ticket_id,$3 AS verdict,$4 AS threat_score,$5 AS confidence,CAST($6 AS JSON) AS recommended_actions,CAST($7 AS JSON) AS assessment_rule_ids,$8 AS assessment_status,CAST($9 AS UNSIGNED) AS approval_allowed,CAST($10 AS UNSIGNED) AS auto_allowed,$11 AS policy_reason,t.id AS ticket_db_id,t.ticket_key,t.status AS ticket_status,t.user_names AS ticket_db_users,t.rule_ids AS ticket_db_rules,t.latest_event AS ticket_db_latest FROM (SELECT 1) AS request LEFT JOIN security_incident_tickets t ON t.id=CAST($12 AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT a.assessment_id, a.ticket_id, a.rule_ids, a.verdict, a.threat_score, a.confidence,
       a.recommended_actions, a.policy_reason, a.assessment_status, a.approval_allowed, a.auto_allowed,
       t.ticket_key, t.src_ip AS ticket_src_ip, t.rule_ids AS ticket_rule_ids,
       t.first_seen AS ticket_first_seen, t.last_seen AS ticket_last_seen,
       t.latest_event AS ticket_latest_event
FROM (
  SELECT $1 AS assessment_id, $2 AS ticket_id, CAST($3 AS JSON) AS rule_ids,
         $4 AS verdict, CAST($5 AS UNSIGNED) AS threat_score, CAST($6 AS DECIMAL(5,4)) AS confidence,
         CAST($7 AS JSON) AS recommended_actions, $8 AS policy_reason, $9 AS assessment_status,
         CAST($10 AS UNSIGNED) AS approval_allowed, CAST($11 AS UNSIGNED) AS auto_allowed
) AS a
LEFT JOIN security_incident_tickets t ON t.ticket_key = a.ticket_id
LIMIT 1
